text:
maria: Rolling out llm-router v4 tonight 02:30 UTC. Feature flag name: ff.llm_route.v4_stagger. Plan: 5% -> 20% after 12m -> 60% after 25m -> 100% after 45m. Quiet window 02:15-03:00 UTC.

maria: We'll pin canary to model=rp-v2.0.9 and keep pinned cohorts on dedicated pool. If we hit the p95 or 5xx gate we fall back to v3 pool for up to 90s and then abort if persistent.

deploybot: job=db-81221 scheduled by @maria. Steps queued with holdpoints. Auto-gates: p95>280ms OR 5xx>0.7% sustained 3m -> pause. Manual abort allowed by release-leads, eng-oncall.

derek: Add a manual ack requirement for the 20% -> 60% step. Also can we add a temporary token-rate ceiling to avoid cache thundering in first 10m?

maria: Ack requirement added. Token-rate ceiling of 1200 tps for canary enabled for 10m.

hao: Quick note on rollback commands for oncall: please put them here so I can pin. Also how to revoke the model pin?

maria: Rollback snippets below (ops-safe):

```bash
# emergency abort whole job
deploybot abort db-81221 --reason "rollback: elevated errors"
# immediate ff off
redwoodctl flags set ff.llm_route.v4_stagger 0 --note "emergency revert"
# push traffic to v3 pool
redwoodctl routing migrate llm-route --to v3-backend --force
# unpin model from cohorts
redwoodctl runtime unpin --service llm-router --selector "cohort:canary"
```

deploybot: Automated fallback to v3-backend will run once for transient spikes. Persistent gate breaches will trigger a pause and notify release-leads. Audit events recorded.

derek: I'll monitor dashboards (p95, 5xx, cache misses, mem OOMs). If I see sustained p95>280ms for 3m I'll call abort and paste the reason here.

hao: I'll be oncall 02:10-03:10 UTC. Will ack at holdpoints if green. If I miss ack within 8m deploybot will hold and page eng-oncall.

maria: Canary start at 02:30 UTC. Posting checkpoints as we hit holds. :rocket:

deploybot: Canary started: cohort=5% job=db-81221 step=canary-start ts=1823334445. Monitoring live."
